rules.statement: A reasonable cause, genuine and lawful, entitles a tenant to be absent from premises for a continuous period of 6 months to avoid ejectment under Section 28.
rules.supporting_quote: (1) Section 28 envisages a reasonable cause of the tenant to be absent from the premises in question for a continuous period of 6 months to avoid ejectment. It has to be genuine and a lawful cause to get the protection of the statue for a tenant. (2) The period spent outside the Island by the tenant is admitted, the version of the tenant does not indicate as to whether the landlord was informed about the departure. 267 (3) There is an absence of exclusive possession of the dependents of the tenant. There were outsiders in the premises. Possession by unknown persons should be only with the landlords' consent

rules.statement: The absence of information to the landlord about the tenant's departure affects the determination of whether the period spent outside the island should be considered.

rules.statement: Possession of a tenant's dependents must be with the landlord's consent.
